note: Curated walking tours; routes follow mapped paths and are illustrative only — not for navigation.

tours.title: HKUST essentials: from the North Gate to the sea
tours.summary: From the North Bus Station through the Academic Building, the library and the business school, down the hillside to the halls and sports facilities by the water.

stops.name: North Bus Station
stops.text: North Bus Station: buses and green minibuses to Hang Hau, Choi Hung and Diamond Hill stop here; the routes are listed in the inspector.

stops.name: Academic Building
stops.text: Academic Building: the main teaching building, around the Atrium. Banks, a convenience store and the S H Ho Sports Hall are mapped inside.

stops.name: Piazza (Red Bird Sundial)
stops.text: The Piazza and the Red Bird sundial: the open square at the heart of the campus, looking over Port Shelter.

stops.name: Lee Shau Kee Library
stops.text: Lee Shau Kee Library: the University library; food outlets are mapped inside.

stops.name: Lee Shau Kee Business Building
stops.text: Lee Shau Kee Business Building (LSK): the business school, with restaurants and a café mapped inside.

stops.name: Cheng Yu Tung Building
stops.text: Cheng Yu Tung Building (CYT); food outlets are mapped inside.

stops.name: HKUST Jockey Club Institute for Advanced Study / Lo Ka Chung Building
stops.text: Jockey Club Institute for Advanced Study (IAS), in the Lo Ka Chung Building.

stops.name: Shaw Auditorium
stops.text: Shaw Auditorium: the campus performance venue.

stops.name: Hall VI
stops.text: Hall VI, one of the undergraduate halls on the slope; the Seafront Cafeteria is mapped inside.

stops.name: Tsang Shiu Tim Sports Center
stops.text: Tsang Shiu Tim Sports Center, beside the waterfront playing fields.

stops.name: Water Sports Center
stops.text: Water Sports Center on the seafront of Port Shelter.
